name: Jar of Eyeballs
description:
You may hold the gaze of one of the eyeballs for one minute to become attuned to it. You may maintain this attunement for up to 1 hour with concentration. While you are attuned to it, you can see what the eyeball sees while your eyes are closed. Additionally, you may spend an action to cause it to rotate in any direction, but not to move.

Once an eyeball is removed from the jar's liquid, it will dry out and cease to function after one hour, regardless of whether it returns to the liquid.

Contains 5 eyeballs.
